wars.name: Sudarma Wisuta war
wars.outcome: Ranawijaya's army under Udara breached Trowulan and killed Kertabumi in 1478; the realm was split between Trowulan and Daha from 1468.

certainty.note: Only Trowulan is named; the realm's frontiers are not on the page.
